items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser that cleans without stripping skin that looks dry and sensitive.
A ceramide moisturizer to support the look of a comfortable, well-cushioned skin barrier.
A mineral SPF 50 is a gentle daily choice for fair skin that looks easily reddened.

response.routine_note: Lingering flushing, bumps and gritty eyes are best looked at by a dermatologist or eye professional rather than by a stronger product from a shop, so please book a visit. Until then, keep to this gentle routine and avoid scrubs, exfoliating acids and retinoids, which can aggravate skin that looks easily reddened.
